section_summary: This section records negotiations over Japanese naval transports and cargo vessels seeking fuel and supplies at United States ports in late 1940 and early 1941. The State Department, Japanese Embassy, Navy, War Department, Treasury, and immigration authorities exchanged requests and notices as visits shifted from Los Angeles to San Francisco and proposed calls in Hawaii were declined. A separate memorandum considers whether Japanese naval tankers had to file commercial cargo manifests.

people.name: Henry M. Hart, Jr.
people.role: Special Assistant to the Attorney General, in charge pro tem of the Immigration and Naturalization Service

people.name: Mr. Arzt
people.role: Bureau of Marine Inspection and Navigation official

subfiles.title: Navy concurrence on revised transport visits
subfiles.about: The Navy favors fueling Naruto, Tsurumi and Kyokuto Maru at San Francisco and omitting Honolulu calls.
subfiles.summary: Concurs in replacing Los Angeles fueling with San Francisco and dropping Honolulu visits.

subfiles.title: Embassy telephone request to change visits
subfiles.about: The Japanese Embassy proposes revised San Francisco dates for Naruto and Kyokuto Maru.
subfiles.summary: Records Mrs. Wenz's request and the Department's promise to consider it.

subfiles.title: Revised visit dates conveyed to Japanese Ambassador
subfiles.about: The Department addresses revised San Francisco visits by Naruto and Kyokuto Maru.
subfiles.summary: Conveys revised dates and port arrangements for the two vessels.

subfiles.title: Notice of revised visits to Governor of California
subfiles.about: California is notified that some Los Angeles visits have shifted and Honolulu calls are cancelled.
subfiles.summary: Requests notice to appropriate authorities of the revised vessel schedule.

subfiles.title: Notice of revised visits to Treasury
subfiles.about: Treasury is informed of changes to Naruto, Tsurumi and Kyokuto Maru visits.
subfiles.summary: Advises that Honolulu visits are cancelled and requests notification of relevant authorities.

subfiles.title: Notice of revised visits to Agriculture
subfiles.about: Agriculture is advised of revised visits, including Tsurumi's Los Angeles call.
subfiles.summary: Requests notification of authorities about altered port dates and cancelled Honolulu visits.

subfiles.title: Notice of revised visits to Attorney General
subfiles.about: The Attorney General is informed of altered Japanese vessel visits.
subfiles.summary: Requests notification of authorities about revised port calls and cancelled Honolulu visits.

subfiles.title: Notice of revised visits to Navy
subfiles.about: The Navy receives the altered schedule for three Japanese vessels.
subfiles.summary: Reports revised visits and cancellation of Honolulu calls.

subfiles.title: Notice of cancelled Honolulu visits to Interior
subfiles.about: Interior is told that the proposed Honolulu visits will not occur.
subfiles.summary: Requests notification of appropriate authorities about the changed schedule.

subfiles.title: Notice of revised visits to War Department
subfiles.about: War Department is informed of revised vessel dates and cancelled Honolulu visits.
subfiles.summary: Requests notification of authorities concerning changes from the earlier Los Angeles and Honolulu schedule.

subfiles.title: War Department acknowledgment of date changes
subfiles.about: War Department relays revised San Francisco dates and cancelled Honolulu calls to its commands.
subfiles.summary: Ninth Corps Area and Hawaiian Department have been advised by radiogram.

subfiles.title: Treasury customs arrangements for Naruto and Kyokuto Maru
subfiles.about: Treasury authorizes customs courtesies for the San Francisco fueling visits.
subfiles.summary: Also encloses notices to Los Angeles and Honolulu customs collectors.

subfiles.title: Amended customs authorization at Los Angeles
subfiles.about: Los Angeles customs courtesies remain authorized for Tsurumi, but Naruto and Kyokuto Maru will not call.
subfiles.summary: Amends the earlier authorization to cover Tsurumi's crude petroleum visit only.

subfiles.title: Cancellation notice to Honolulu customs collector
subfiles.about: Treasury informs Honolulu customs that Naruto and Tsurumi's calls are cancelled.
subfiles.summary: Withdraws the anticipated provisioning visits.

subfiles.title: Japanese request for longer San Francisco visits
subfiles.about: Japan requests Naruto's October 17 arrival, an extra day for Kyokuto Maru, and reconsideration of Honolulu calls.
subfiles.summary: Naruto had already sailed under its original schedule and would otherwise wait at sea. The Embassy seeks six days for fueling, machinery work and crew rest, plus an additional day for Kyokuto Maru; it again asks for Naruto and Tsurumi to call at Honolulu.

subfiles.title: Japanese requests referred to Navy
subfiles.about: State forwards requested extended San Francisco stays for Naruto and Kyokuto Maru.
subfiles.summary: Explains Naruto's need for fuel, engine inspection, boiler cleaning and crew rest.

subfiles.title: Approval of revised San Francisco visits
subfiles.about: The Department approves Naruto and Kyokuto Maru's longer San Francisco visits.
subfiles.summary: Approves October 17–22 and October 21–24 respectively; Honolulu remains inconvenient.

subfiles.title: Copy of approval of revised San Francisco visits
subfiles.about: A second copy records approval of longer San Francisco stays.
subfiles.summary: Repeats approval for Naruto and Kyokuto Maru and the refusal of Honolulu calls.

subfiles.title: Request to extend Tsurumi's Los Angeles stay
subfiles.about: Japan asks that Tsurumi remain in Los Angeles through November 4.
subfiles.summary: The longer stay would permit crude petroleum loading, engine inspection, boiler cleaning and crew rest.

subfiles.title: Approval of Tsurumi's extended stay
subfiles.about: The Department approves Tsurumi's stay in Los Angeles through November 4.
subfiles.summary: Confirms federal approval of the requested extension.

subfiles.title: Tsurumi extension referred to Navy
subfiles.about: State informs the Navy of Japan's request to extend Tsurumi's Los Angeles visit.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the proposed extension beyond the original November 1 departure.

subfiles.title: Japanese request for Shiriya to visit Los Angeles
subfiles.about: Japan renews its request for Shiriya to call at Los Angeles November 9–14.
subfiles.summary: The Embassy notes an earlier indication that Los Angeles and Honolulu were inconvenient but asks for special consideration of Los Angeles after a discussion with Mr. Hamilton.

subfiles.title: Shiriya notice to Governor of California
subfiles.about: State requests usual courtesies for Shiriya's proposed Los Angeles fueling visit.
subfiles.summary: Seeks facilities for November 9–14, subject to objection.

subfiles.title: Shiriya notice to Attorney General
subfiles.about: State requests usual courtesies for Shiriya at Los Angeles.
subfiles.summary: Advises of the proposed November 9–14 crude petroleum call.

subfiles.title: Shiriya notice to War Department
subfiles.about: State requests usual courtesies for Shiriya's Los Angeles visit.
subfiles.summary: Reports a November 9–14 call to take on crude petroleum.

subfiles.title: Shiriya notice to Treasury
subfiles.about: State requests Treasury's usual facilities for Shiriya's proposed visit.
subfiles.summary: The surviving text is damaged but belongs to the Los Angeles Shiriya circular.

subfiles.title: Shiriya notice to Navy
subfiles.about: State seeks Navy views on Shiriya's November 9–14 Los Angeles visit.
subfiles.summary: Requests usual courtesies for crude petroleum loading and encloses the Embassy note.

subfiles.title: Interim acknowledgment of Shiriya request
subfiles.about: State acknowledges the request for Shiriya's Los Angeles visit.
subfiles.summary: Promises a further answer after consulting federal authorities.

subfiles.title: Los Angeles refusal and San Francisco alternative for Shiriya
subfiles.about: State finds Shiriya's Los Angeles visit inconvenient and offers San Francisco on the same dates.
subfiles.summary: Proposes usual facilities at San Francisco November 9–14.

subfiles.title: Conversation with Embassy counselor on naval visits
subfiles.about: Mr. Morishima and Mr. Hamilton discuss Shiriya, Hawaiian ports, Los Angeles and short notice for visit requests.
subfiles.summary: Records Japan's Los Angeles preference and a promise to submit future requests earlier.

subfiles.title: Informal Japanese statement on naval transport restrictions
subfiles.about: Japan protests curtailed naval transport calls and tabulates requested and approved schedules.
subfiles.summary: The statement says denials at Honolulu and Los Angeles and shortened stays impede fueling and provisioning and could harm relations. Its schedule compares requests and replies for Naruto, Tsurumi, Kyokuto Maru and Shiriya, including an informal inquiry about Hilo.

subfiles.title: War Department acknowledgment of Shiriya's Los Angeles visit
subfiles.about: War Department instructs Ninth Corps Area to extend courtesies to Shiriya in Los Angeles.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges the proposed November 9–14 fueling visit.

subfiles.title: Copy of War Department Shiriya acknowledgment
subfiles.about: A duplicate acknowledges Shiriya's proposed Los Angeles call.
subfiles.summary: Repeats Ninth Corps Area instructions to extend courtesies.

subfiles.title: Immigration notice for Shiriya at Los Angeles
subfiles.about: Immigration authorities will advise their field office of Shiriya's Los Angeles visit.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges the November 9–14 crude petroleum call.

subfiles.title: Japanese request for Hayatomo, Iro and Kyokuto Maru visits
subfiles.about: Japan requests Los Angeles fueling and Hilo or Honolulu provisioning calls for three vessels.
subfiles.summary: Asks whether the visits, crew landings and usual facilities are agreeable.

subfiles.title: Three-vessel request referred to Navy
subfiles.about: State forwards the Hayatomo, Iro and Kyokuto Maru schedule for Navy consideration.
subfiles.summary: Lists proposed Los Angeles, Hilo and Honolulu calls and their fueling or provisioning purposes.

subfiles.title: Interim acknowledgment of three-vessel request
subfiles.about: State acknowledges the proposed visits by Hayatomo, Iro and Kyokuto Maru.
subfiles.summary: Promises a reply after consulting federal authorities.

subfiles.title: Embassy accepts San Francisco for Shiriya
subfiles.about: Japan confirms Shiriya will call at San Francisco instead of Los Angeles.
subfiles.summary: Accepts the November 9–14 San Francisco alternative.

subfiles.title: Shiriya change notice to Governor of California
subfiles.about: State changes Shiriya's November 9–14 call from Los Angeles to San Francisco.
subfiles.summary: Requests usual courtesies for the revised fueling visit.

subfiles.title: Shiriya change notice to Agriculture
subfiles.about: State notifies Agriculture of Shiriya's change to San Francisco.
subfiles.summary: Requests usual facilities for the November 9–14 visit.

subfiles.title: Shiriya change notice to War Department
subfiles.about: State changes Shiriya's proposed call to San Francisco.
subfiles.summary: Requests usual courtesies for the revised November 9–14 visit.

subfiles.title: Copy of Shiriya change notice to War Department
subfiles.about: A duplicate records Shiriya's change from Los Angeles to San Francisco.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the request for usual courtesies.

subfiles.title: Shiriya change notice to Navy
subfiles.about: State asks Navy to extend courtesies to Shiriya at San Francisco.
subfiles.summary: Explains that the proposed Los Angeles call was inconvenient.

subfiles.title: Telephone memorandum on Tsurumi delay
subfiles.about: The Embassy reports Tsurumi's delay and the Navy accepts a longer Los Angeles stay.
subfiles.summary: Records Mrs. Wenz's call and Commander McCracken's assent to a November 5 departure.

subfiles.title: Tsurumi delay notice to Navy
subfiles.about: State relays the Embassy's revised Los Angeles timing for delayed Tsurumi.
subfiles.summary: Reports a change to the previously approved schedule.

subfiles.title: Navy objection to Shiriya at Los Angeles
subfiles.about: Navy prefers Shiriya to visit San Francisco because of fleet activity at Los Angeles.
subfiles.summary: Notes Tsurumi's approved Los Angeles visit and considers sequential Japanese calls there undesirable.

subfiles.title: Treasury authorizes Shiriya customs courtesies at Los Angeles
subfiles.about: Treasury authorizes customs facilities for Shiriya's originally proposed Los Angeles call.
subfiles.summary: Covers crude petroleum loading November 9–14.

subfiles.title: War Department acknowledges Shiriya port change
subfiles.about: War Department advises Ninth Corps Area that Shiriya will visit San Francisco.
subfiles.summary: Updates the earlier Los Angeles instructions and orders usual courtesies.

subfiles.title: Copy of War Department Shiriya port-change acknowledgment
subfiles.about: A duplicate confirms War Department notice of Shiriya's San Francisco visit.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the Ninth Corps Area instructions.

subfiles.title: Treasury transfers Shiriya customs authorization
subfiles.about: Treasury authorizes customs courtesies at San Francisco and revokes Los Angeles authorization.
subfiles.summary: The revised visit is November 9–14 for crude petroleum.

subfiles.title: Immigration notice for Shiriya at San Francisco
subfiles.about: Immigration authorities notify their San Francisco field office of Shiriya's revised visit.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges the change from Los Angeles for November 9–14.

subfiles.title: Refusal of Los Angeles and Hawaiian calls
subfiles.about: State declines Hayatomo, Iro and Kyokuto Maru calls at Los Angeles, Hilo and Honolulu.
subfiles.summary: Offers to arrange usual facilities at San Francisco instead.

subfiles.title: Navy objection to proposed three-vessel itinerary
subfiles.about: Navy prefers San Francisco and continuation of its policy against Japanese public-vessel calls in Hawaii.
subfiles.summary: Cites fleet activity at Los Angeles and recommends omitting Hilo and Honolulu.

subfiles.title: Revised Japanese request for three San Francisco visits
subfiles.about: Japan requests San Francisco calls for Hayatomo, Iro and Kyokuto Maru in place of the earlier itinerary.
subfiles.summary: The Embassy lists late November and December fueling dates and again requests crew landing and usual facilities.

subfiles.title: Three-vessel San Francisco notice to Governor
subfiles.about: State requests courtesies for three Japanese vessels fueling at San Francisco.
subfiles.summary: Lists visits by Hayatomo, Iro and Kyokuto Maru and requests crew landing.

subfiles.title: Three-vessel San Francisco notice to Attorney General
subfiles.about: State seeks usual courtesies and crew landing for three San Francisco visits.
subfiles.summary: Lists Hayatomo, Iro and Kyokuto Maru fueling dates.

subfiles.title: Three-vessel San Francisco notice to Navy
subfiles.about: State requests Navy concurrence in San Francisco calls by Hayatomo, Iro and Kyokuto Maru.
subfiles.summary: Seeks usual facilities for crude petroleum loading.

subfiles.title: Interim acknowledgment of revised three-vessel request
subfiles.about: State acknowledges the revised San Francisco request and crew landing proposal.
subfiles.summary: Promises a further answer after consultation.

subfiles.title: Approval of three San Francisco visits
subfiles.about: State approves San Francisco calls by Kyokuto Maru, Hayatomo and Iro.
subfiles.summary: Confirms the vessels will receive usual courtesies and facilities.

subfiles.title: Treasury customs authorization for three vessels
subfiles.about: Treasury authorizes San Francisco customs courtesies for Hayatomo, Iro and Kyokuto Maru.
subfiles.summary: The three vessels are to load crude petroleum.

subfiles.title: Immigration notice for three San Francisco visits
subfiles.about: Immigration authorities notify their San Francisco field office of three Japanese vessel visits.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges the late November and December fueling schedule.

subfiles.title: War Department notice for three San Francisco visits
subfiles.about: War Department instructs Ninth Corps Area to extend courtesies to the three vessels.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges Hayatomo, Iro and Kyokuto Maru's San Francisco fueling calls.

subfiles.title: Telephone conversation on naval tanker cargo manifests
subfiles.about: Commerce asks whether Japanese naval tankers loading oil at San Francisco must file commercial cargo manifests.
subfiles.summary: Mr. Arzt proposes that public vessels need neither enter nor clear and thus need not file cargo manifests. Mr. Falck refers him to the Department's earlier letter and the Bureau of Marine Inspection and Navigation memorandum.

subfiles.title: Copy of tanker cargo-manifest conversation
subfiles.about: A duplicate records the inquiry about manifests for Japanese naval tankers.
subfiles.summary: Mr. Arzt proposes exemption as public vessels; State points to its earlier written position.

subfiles.title: Further copy of tanker cargo-manifest conversation
subfiles.about: A third copy records the San Francisco naval tanker manifest inquiry.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the proposed public-vessel exemption and reference to earlier guidance.

subfiles.title: Japanese request for Toei Maru and Hoyo Maru visits
subfiles.about: Japan requests San Francisco fueling visits for Toei Maru and Hoyo Maru.
subfiles.summary: Proposes Toei Maru calls in February and March and a Hoyo Maru call in March, with crew landing.

subfiles.title: Interim acknowledgment of February vessel request
subfiles.about: State acknowledges the requested Toei Maru and Hoyo Maru visits.
subfiles.summary: Reports consultation with federal authorities.

subfiles.title: February vessel request to War Department
subfiles.about: State seeks courtesies for Toei Maru and Hoyo Maru's San Francisco fueling calls.
subfiles.summary: Includes proposed crew landing and February–March schedule.

subfiles.title: February vessel request to Navy
subfiles.about: State seeks Navy concurrence in Toei Maru and Hoyo Maru's San Francisco calls.
subfiles.summary: Requests usual facilities for crude petroleum and crew landing.

subfiles.title: February vessel request to Attorney General
subfiles.about: State seeks usual courtesies for Toei Maru and Hoyo Maru.
subfiles.summary: Lists San Francisco fueling visits and requests crew landing.

subfiles.title: February vessel request to Governor of California
subfiles.about: State requests California's usual facilities for Toei Maru and Hoyo Maru at San Francisco.
subfiles.summary: Lists proposed February–March fueling visits and crew landing.
